name: accounts
title: Runtime accounts
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Choose runtime-owned profiles and opt-in fresh-work capacity policy without reading credentials.
description: A replaceable metadata-only account registry for Pi, Codex and Claude Code. Native sign-in opens a backend terminal; each runtime owns its profile, credentials and refresh. vqro never scans or reads profile contents, stores tokens, claims authentication success or replays input. Normal login leaves native defaults unchanged. Disabling this UI does not stop agents or remove native logins.

needs.why: Native sign-in needs a backend terminal

works_with.without: Fresh-restart effects refuse without protected claims; selection and notifications still work
Native Pi sign-in uses its documented default argv
Native Codex sign-in uses its documented default argv
Native Claude sign-in uses its documented default argv
Native sign-in terminal remains available in the resource picker
